name: Traffic
tip: Every XPRS packet heard and which bearer carried it - including packets meant for other stations. Tap one to read it in full.

children.name: packets
children.empty:
Nothing heard yet.
Leave Bluetooth on, or bring another station into range.

This view is radio only - a peer reached over the internet never appears here.

children.name: detail
children.empty: Pick a packet on the Traffic screen.

name: Stations
tip: Stations heard over the air only - BLE, LAN or LoRa. Never the internet.

children.name: stations
children.empty:
Nothing heard yet.
Leave Bluetooth on, or bring another station into range.

name: Carry
tip: Mail the stations around you are carrying. Open a station's bag and choose what to take with you - what you take, you deliver when its recipient is next in your range.

children.name: remote
children.empty:
No station in range says it is carrying mail.

A station announces its load in its beacon; when one appears on the Stations screen with a mail count, its bag opens here.

name: Carried
tip: Mail this device is holding for other people, so it reaches them when they are next in range. A mesh where nobody carries only works when both people are awake and in range at the same moment - which is the thing store-and-forward exists to fix.

children.name: carry_on
children.label: Carry mail for other stations
children.tip: On by default. Off keeps your own outgoing mail but accepts nothing on anyone else's behalf.

children.name: held
children.empty:
Carrying nothing right now.

When a neighbour hands over mail for someone out of range, it waits here until that station is heard again.
